pages.title: City to City NYC — Starting & Strengthening Churches in New York City
pages.content: City to City NYC is a church-planting network and ministry of Redeemer City to City. We prayerfully help leaders start and strengthen gospel-centered churches across all five boroughs, through two pathways — Start a Church and Strengthen a Church — and from our home, Nova Omnia, on the Upper East Side.

pages.title: Programs — Start & Strengthen a Church
pages.content:
## Our Programs

City to City NYC offers two integrated pathways — one for those beginning the planting journey, and one for those deepening the health of an existing congregation. Every program is shaped by the realities of urban ministry in New York City and grounded in the gospel.

---

## Start a Church

### Incubator Collective
A rigorous, two-year cohort experience for newly planted and aspiring church planters. Participants engage in theological formation, peer learning, and one-on-one coaching while actively doing ministry. The Incubator Collective is built on the belief that planters are formed in community, not in isolation.

**Who it's for:** Planters in the early stages of a new church, or those preparing to launch within the next year.

### Fellows Program
For leaders who sense a clear call to plant but are still two to three years from launching, the Fellows Program provides the runway needed to build a solid theological foundation, develop a ministry philosophy, and step into a trusted network of mentors and peers.

**Who it's for:** Aspiring planters at the discernment and preparation stage.

### Incubador Grupal
Our Spanish-language cohort creates a dedicated space for Latino and Spanish-speaking leaders to be trained, encouraged, and sent out to plant gospel-centered churches that reflect the rich diversity of New York City.

**Who it's for:** Spanish-speaking leaders called to church planting in NYC's Latino communities.

---

## Strengthen a Church

### City Ministry Program
A certificate program in practical urban ministry offering pastors and ministry leaders a structured curriculum in the theology, history, and practice of city-focused church leadership. Grounded, applicable, and designed for working ministers.

**Who it's for:** Pastors and church leaders in established or growing congregations.

### Evangelism Learning Cohort
New York City presents unique challenges and opportunities for evangelism. This cohort helps church leaders develop strategies, practices, and a culture of evangelism that is both theologically faithful and contextually fluent.

**Who it's for:** Pastors and ministry leaders wanting to cultivate evangelistic vitality in their churches.

### Community Engagement Cohort
The gospel sends churches outward. This cohort equips leaders to engage their specific neighborhoods with wisdom and integrity — building genuine, long-term relationships between congregation and community.

**Who it's for:** Leaders committed to justice, mercy, and neighbor love as expressions of gospel witness.

### MasterClasses
Intensive, expert-led sessions on the most relevant and pressing topics in urban ministry. MasterClasses draw on the wisdom of experienced practitioners and are open to leaders across the City to City NYC network.

**Who it's for:** Any ministry leader seeking focused development on a specific topic.

---

## Interested in a Program?

Reach out to learn more about upcoming cohorts, application timelines, and how City to City NYC can serve your ministry calling.

[Contact Us →](/contact)

pages.title: Nova Omnia — A Center for City Renewal
pages.content:
## Nova Omnia
### A Center for City Renewal

*Nova Omnia* — Latin for **all things new** — is City to City NYC's home and hub on the Upper East Side of Manhattan. It is more than an address. It is a statement of conviction: that the gospel of Jesus Christ renews all things — individuals, families, neighborhoods, and the city itself.

Nova Omnia exists to be a gathering place for the leaders, planters, and practitioners who make up the City to City NYC network. It is where cohorts meet, where conversations happen, where vision is sharpened and community is built.

---

## Visit Us

**Nova Omnia — City to City NYC**
150 E. 91st Street, 8th Floor
New York, NY 10128

Located on the Upper East Side, Nova Omnia is easily accessible by subway and bus.

---

## The Vision Behind the Name

The name draws on the ancient Christian hope — that the redemptive work of Christ reaches further than any brokenness, and that the city is not beyond renewal. We plant churches, train leaders, and strengthen congregations because we believe the New York City of tomorrow can look different from the New York City of today — one gospel-rooted community at a time.

---

[Get in Touch →](/contact)

pages.title: About City to City NYC
pages.content:
## About City to City NYC

City to City NYC is a church-planting network and ministry of **Redeemer City to City**, the global organization founded to resource and catalyze gospel movements in the world's great cities. Our particular call is New York City — all five boroughs, every neighborhood, every kind of person.

We believe that healthy, gospel-centered churches are the single greatest force for human flourishing in a city. We exist to see more of them — and to see existing ones grow stronger.

---

## Our Conviction

The gospel is good news for New York City. We are not naïve about the challenges of urban ministry — the cost of living, the pace of life, the deep pluralism, the spiritual skepticism. We take them seriously. But we are equally convinced that the church, formed by the gospel and sent into the city, is exactly what New York needs.

We work with leaders across traditions, ethnicities, and neighborhoods — united by a shared commitment to the gospel and the renewal of the city.

---

## Honoring Tim Keller (1950–2023)

City to City NYC was co-founded by **Timothy J. Keller**, whose ministry at Redeemer Presbyterian Church and whose writing and teaching shaped a generation of urban church leaders around the world. Tim's vision — of a theologically robust, culturally engaged, city-loving church — is the inheritance we steward and the north star we follow.

We are grateful for his life, his faithfulness, and his enduring influence on gospel ministry in New York City and beyond.

---
